content.text:
When you clone a `Mesh`, `Line`, `Points` or `Sprite` now, the copy gets its own material array. The material objects themselves are still shared, as the issue asked. I haven't run any tests on it.

The fix is the same one-line change in each of those four classes' `copy()` methods (in `src/objects/`). If `source.material` is an array, the copy gets a shallow copy of it (`source.material.slice()`). A single material is still passed by reference, as before. `clone()` goes through `copy()`, so it picks this up too.
